speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
text: asked	the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) what kind of financial and emotional support is given to single fathers who are from low- and middle-income families, some of whom also care for elderly family members; (b) how can the Ministry better engage the community and single-parent families so that the support can also come from the community at large; and (c) how can proactive assistance be given to such families instead of them resorting to borrowing money from moneylenders to make ends meet.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Apart from shouldering the cost of caring for their family members alone, they also have to balance work and family commitments.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Such challenges are faced by single fathers and mothers alike.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Correspondingly, the Government provides similar levels of support for both.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Government benefits that support the growth and development of children are given to all children, regardless of the marital status of their parents.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The Government has also put in place a range of initiatives to support caregivers of elderly family members, including single parents.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: These include home- and centre-based care services, respite care services, training grants and subsidies to help defray the costs of care.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: If they need help with socio-emotional issues, they can approach a Family Service Centre.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Apart from participating in evidence-based programmes designed to help parents better understand the impact of divorce on children, parents who require additional emotional support can receive counselling and casework services at these DSSAs.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: This programme will proactively identify low-income and vulnerable children aged six and below, and these may include children of single fathers.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: KidSTART will help to provide them with early access to health, learning and development support, and monitor their progress during their early years.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Aside from the Government, community agencies, such as the Centre for Fathering and Focus on the Family, also provide support to parents, including single-parent families.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Self-help groups have developed programmes and schemes for single parents, especially low-income single-parent families.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Such programmes may include workshops, personal coaching, counselling and family bonding activities.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Through peer support programmes, single-parent families are also roped in to support others going through similar challenges.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: In terms of financial support for the low-income, society at large has also been contributing actively.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The Government then matches the combined amount, thereby helping low-income parents to multiply their child's CDA savings.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Another example is the close partnership between all the five Community Development Councils and the National Trades Union Congress' FairPrice to help low-income families with the purchase of milk powder for their children.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Providing support for the vulnerable in society is a priority for the Government.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We will continue to work at improving the delivery of social assistance and services to build a stronger social safety net for Singaporeans, including single parents.
